name: br_warp_gate
notes: Author's WorldEditor selection (WE_OBJECTS_V1 paste, 3 records, 3/3 found at (1393, 134), the desert gate). FACES SOUTH (facing 180): the portal is looked into from the south. One assembly of three records 1.6 m apart: warpgate01 (the octagonal stone arch on its two-step dais), warpgate02 (the red portal effect) and warpgate02_01. The map has two more, hand-turned copies of the same assembly -- (148, 135) facing south-east and (107, 1428) facing north-east -- whose inner rolls differ by 15 deg; this one is the pattern. No floor: it stands on the road. The dais is about 14 m across, so pad_radius_m 10. rotate_deg = (180 - B) mod 360.
